Sabrina Sanders, Chair  Beth Lesen, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 7:58 a.m. the meeting was called to order. Chair Sanders is presiding.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Clark, Van Meeveren, McNeeley, Tejani, Walton, Schwerin, Sanders

Commissioners Absent: Gupta, Lesen, Red Eagle

Also present: Anissa Davis, City Health Officer, Dennis Keith, Executive Assistant, Elizabeth Lomeli,
Bureau Secretary, Alison King, Director of Health , Alejandra Gutierrez, Executive Assistant.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54787  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Board of Health and Human
  Services meeting of Friday, August 9, 2024.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Schwerin, seconded by Member Tejani, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Clark, Van Meeveren, McNeeley, Tejani, Walton, Schwerin, Sanders
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Gupta, Lesen, Red Eagle

2.  24-54788  Recommendation to receive and file a report from the Director of Health and
  Human Services.

  Alison King, Director of Health and Human Services, provided an update on the
  following:
  • Thanked Board Memebers for attending the public Budget meetings.
  • The City adopted the Budget for FY25.

  Page 1 of 4
   BOARD OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES MINUTES

  • Loss of Funding staff impacts. 22 staffed positions out of the 73 affected
  positions are at risk, efforts are being made to assist affected staff in various
  ways.
  • Dennis Keith, Executive Assistant, is retiring and efforts to fill the Executive
  Assistant potion are in motion.
  • Deputy Director Interviews will be held and Mrs. King invited Board members
  to be part of the interview pannel.
  • Asian American and Pacific Islander Assesment Program was put forward
  with an event.
  Chair Sabina Sanders asked for a presentation regarding the Asian American and
  Pacific Islander Assesment Program.

  A motion was made by Member Van Meeveren, seconded by Member Walton,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Clark, Van Meeveren, McNeeley, Tejani, Walton, Schwerin, Sanders
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Gupta, Lesen, Red Eagle

3.  24-54789  Recommendation of receive and file report from the City Health Officer.

  Anissa Davis, City Health Officer, provided the Board with the following
  information:
  • Provided an update on the local TB outbreak.
  • Provided an update on the Avian Influenza.
  • Avian Influenza vaccine in the works.

  A motion was made by Member Van Meeveren, seconded by Member Walton,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Clark, Van Meeveren, McNeeley, Tejani, Walton, Schwerin, Sanders
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Gupta, Lesen, Red Eagle

4.  24-54790  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the City’s legislative agenda.

  Andrea Lee, Legislative and Partnerships Manager, provided the Board with a
  written report, attached and filed as part of the permanent record.

  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Clark, Van Meeveren, McNeeley, Tejani, Walton, Schwerin, Sanders

5.  24-54387  Recommendation to submit a letter to the Mayor and City Council proposing that
  the City install beach water hazard signage along City waterways.

  A motion was made by Member Clark, seconded by Member Van Meeveren,
  that the item be laid over to the October 11, 2024 Board of Health & Human
  Services meeting. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Clark, Van Meeveren, McNeeley, Tejani, Walton, Schwerin, Sanders
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Gupta, Lesen, Red Eagle

6.  24-54791  Recommendation to discuss Board Goals and Infrastructure.

  The Board discussed the following:
  • Reviewed the Goals and Infrastructure Report created by Mr. James Suazo
  who facilitated a series of strategic planning sessions with the Board.
  • The Board agreed to further review the report over the next several
  meetings.
  • Alison King discussed how to engage and involve the Board in order to make
  more use of their expertise.
  • A strategic plan subcommittee was formed, consisting of Board members
  Walton, Clark, Sanders, McNeely and Schwerin, to review Mr. Suazo’s Goals
  and Infrastructure Report and provide a summary at the next meeting.
  • Board Member Tejani questioned how to get more community involvement
  during Board meetings. A brief discussion ensued.

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Schwerin, seconded by Member Clark, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7 Clark, Van Meeveren, McNeeley, Tejani, Walton, Schwerin, Sanders
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
